title: Audit of FCH uptake cargo (SIWD): S, I and D replicate on fresh seed 7 and at dt/2, but W is a Boltzmann partition written against the body field. Erased solute refills every body to >=2x within 20 t and to 123x within 40 t, so the cargo is re-equilibrated, not contained or inherited
summary: Construction (world.py read line by line). u is functionalized Cahn-Hilliard with a uniform amphiphile feed (dt*feed added everywhere every step, an open source), so total amphiphile grows without bound and micelles multiply until they fill the domain. Division is FCH pearling of micelles that outgrow their size under that global feed, made by the dynamics but not by any individual metabolism. The solute flux is Dc(grad c + chi c grad u) with a uniform source kp0 and decay kd. Its zero-flux state is c proportional to exp(-chi u): the 'containment' is a partition coefficient set by the body field through a hand-written potential, which the rubric treats as imposed (a drift written against the body field). Control 1 (refill.py, seed 7): at t=300 the solute was reset to its uniform background everywhere. Every body was back above 2x within 20 t, the median contrast went 1.0 -> 37 -> 123 -> 266 by t=320/340/400, above the untouched arm (119 -> 164), and both climb toward the local Boltzmann factor exp(-chi (u_body - u_out)) of ~820-900. So a body holds solute because of its own amphiphile level, not because it kept what it had: a daughter's 'inherited' cargo is re-equilibration, as the claim's limits say. Replication: fresh seed 7 (t=800): 51 persistent splits, generation 5, 0 merges, 80 final bodies, contrast 318x with 100% of bodies >= 2x; at dt/2: 45 splits, generation 6, contrast 232x (30% lower at the same time: the contrast value is not converged in dt, the >= 2x property is).

controls_run.W: refill_s7.json: solute erased to its uniform background at t=300; every body refills to >= 2x in 20 t and the median contrast to 123x in 40 t, toward the Boltzmann factor ~850 of each body's own amphiphile level

by_construction: W (equilibrium partition c ~ exp(-chi u), a potential written against the body field; contrast is a function of the body's amphiphile level and refills after erasure, so it is not containment and needs no barrier)
D is driven by a uniform open amphiphile feed: every micelle grows and pearls in synchronized waves until the domain fills
verdicts.limitation: The claim's 'no uniform-D twin can hold it' is true but empty: the contrast comes from a hand-written potential chi c grad u, so any Laplacian twin fails trivially, and P_BD credit for W should not follow from it. W as containment (holding contents against loss) is not shown, since refilled bodies hold more than kept ones. One seed plus its dt/2 variant. I did not test the 1.5x resolution run or a source restricted to bodies.
